notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: Your role doesn't include the permission required for this page.
forbidden.hint: Switch to an account with more permissions to explore this area.

routeError.title: This page failed to load
routeError.description: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page.

unauthorized.title: Your session has expired
unauthorized.description: Sign in again to continue where you left off.
unauthorized.hint: If this keeps happening, the session may have been revoked from another device or the account may be inactive.

serverError.title: Something went wrong on our side
serverError.description: The page could not be loaded because of an unexpected server error.
serverError.hint: Try reloading. If the problem persists, check the browser console or the mock API logs.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: The server is starting up or briefly overloaded.
unavailable.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again. A real app would surface its retry policy here.

maintenance.title: We'll be back shortly
maintenance.description: FishAdmin is being updated to serve you better.
maintenance.hint: Scheduled window: 02:00–02:30 UTC. Data already saved in your browser is safe.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Changes can't be saved until the connection returns.

api.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
api.forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this action.
api.notFound: The requested resource could not be found.
api.validation: Please check the submitted values and try again.
api.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
api.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

boundary.title: Something broke
boundary.description: The application hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually helps.
